name: Bandle Bounty I
description: Reach level 10 and field 10 unique Yordles to reveal the Bandle Path's secret. Gain a Lulu and a Rumble.

name: Bandle Bounty II
description: For every Yordle you've unlocked or unlock, gain scaling gold. Reach level 10 and field 10 unique Yordles to reveal the Bandle Path's secret. Gain a Tristana and Teemo.

name: Blood Offering
description: Gain a Bloodthirster. Combat start: Allies holding Bloodthirsters lose scaling Health but gain a scaling Health shield and scaling Attack Damage and Ability Power.

name: Bringer of Ruin
description: Every takedown Atakhan scores permanently grants him scaling Ability Power and scaling max Health. Gain a Briar and a Sion. (Current Takedowns: scaling)

name: Chaotic Evolution
description: Starring up a champion grants them one of the following: scaling Health, scaling Durability, scaling Ability Power, scaling Attack Damage, scaling Attack Speed. Bonuses stack.

name: Corrosion
description: Enemies in the first two rows lose scaling Armor and Magic Resist every scaling seconds.

name: Defense of the Placidium
description: Your team gains scaling Durability, increased to scaling if the Ionia trait is active.

name: Demacia Forever
description: Demacians gain scaling permanent Health every time they rally. They also gain scaling permanent Attack Damage and Ability Power every scaling rallies. Gain a Jarvan IV, a Sona, and a Xin Zhao.

name: Dragonguards
description: Gain a Shyvana and a 2-star Jarvan IV. When Jarvan casts, Shyvana gains Shield. When Shyvana casts, Jarvan jumps in and deals damage based on his Armor and Magic Resist. After every player combat, gain a Jarvan IV.

name: Evolve and Overcome
description: For every scaling champions that Mutated Void allies takedown, gain scaling XP. Gain a Cho'Gath and a 2-star Kog'Maw. scaling Void provides unique Mutations.

name: Heavy Is the Crown
description: Gain a Crown of Demacia, which provides significant bonuses to the wearer. If the holder dies, lose the round.

name: Indecision I
description: In scaling rounds, choose a new augment of the same tier. Gain scaling gold now.

name: Indiscriminate Killer
description: Gain a Giant Slayer. Giant Slayers gain their Damage Amp against all enemies instead of just Tanks.

name: Ixtal Expeditionist
description: Gain a Qiyana, a Neeko, and a Milio. Increase your current and max player Health by scaling.

name: Lifting Competition
description: At the start of each round, if the combined Health of all your unique Bruisers is high enough, gain a reward and increase the threshold (up to four times). Gain a Shen and a Sion. scalingscaling / scaling

name: Luxury Subscription
description: Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and scaling gold. At the start of the next scaling stages, gain the package again.

name: Poison Pals
description: Gain a 2-star Teemo. Singed's damage refreshes Teemo's poisons, and every scaling magic damage Teemo deals grants your strongest Singed scaling Ability Power. Gain a Teemo after each player combat.

name: Radiant Relics
description: Choose 1 of scaling Radiant items. Gain a Magnetic Remover. Radiant items are very powerful versions of completed items.

name: Walk The True Path I
description: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator and a Yasuo. Reach level 10 and field 10 unique Ionians to unlock a Prismatic Upgrade.

name: Walk The True Path II
description: Gain scaling Lesser Champion Duplicators, a Yasuo, and a B.F. Sword. Reach level 10 and field 10 unique Ionians to unlock a Prismatic Upgrade.

name: Wild Growth
description: 3-star Yordles become massive, moving slower but gaining scaling Health and scaling Attack Damage and Ability Power. Gain a Rumble and Lulu.
